row.reason: J.B. Hunt is a North American land-based freight provider covering intermodal rail, dedicated trucking, brokerage and final-mile delivery for retail, consumer and manufacturing shippers. Genco owns ocean dry bulk vessels and charters them to miners, steelmakers and commodity traders worldwide. Both are asset-based freight carriers paid per movement or charter. The mode, the service and the buyers all differ: container and truck freight for retailers versus Capesize and Supramax charters for bulk commodities. The only link is the broad label of freight transportation.

T:P2.1.text: Our Company | Creating Transportation Efficiency | J.B. Hunt

T:P2.2.text: J.B. Hunt provides a variety of freight transportation services to customers throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

T:P2.3.text: We got our start with five trucks, seven trailers and Mr. Hunt’s vision to create something big. We’ve grown a lot but our legacy of innovation and impact lives on. Together, we’re working toward our vision to create the most efficient transportation network in North America.

T:P2.5.text: Our vision is to create the most efficient transportation network in North America. This statement keeps us focused on the future and what we’re aspiring for as a company. It encourages us to not only innovate solutions that make our company better, but to find ways to improve the greater supply chain.

C:P1.4.text: We are the largest U.S.-headquartered drybulk shipping company. Through our in-house commercial operating platform, we provide a full-service logistics solution for the transportation of commodities worldwide using a diversified fleet of modern, fuel-efficient vessels.

C:P1.5.text: Our mission of building an organization that concentrates on achieving the highest level of integrity has translated into measurable results. C:P1.6.text: Over the last several years, Genco has implemented a disciplined approach towards allocating capital maintaining among the lowest leverage positions in its drybulk peer group. Given the cyclicality of the business, this approach has been prudent in light of the unique events that have materialized in recent years.
